in_hindi.name: Biraja
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of distress, compassionate
in_hindi.long_meaning: Biraja एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biraja is a name of Shakti, the Hindu goddess of distress and compassion. She is also known as Tara, Bhavani, and Shitala. Biraja is believed to provide relief to those in distress and is a symbol of compassion and comfort.
